messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Japanese, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Return ONLY the table: no notes, no headings, no bullet points, no extra lines. Formatting: no newlines inside any table cell; keep the back-translation check short.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |---|---|---| | Tant' | degree adverb “so” | Use intensifier 「とても」 before adjective; BT: “very” | | è | copular verb “is” | Use copula 「です」 or 「である」; BT: “is” | | amara | adjective “bitter” | Use adjective 「苦い」; BT: “bitter” | | che | subordinator introducing comparative clause | Use connective 「というのは」 to link clauses; BT: “that” | | poco | degree adverb “little” | Use adverb 「少しだけ」 modifying comparative; BT: “a little” | | è | copular verb in comparative clause | Use topic marker 「は」 with predicate; BT: “is” | | più | comparative adverb “more” | Express comparison with 「より」 after benchmark noun; BT: “more” | | morte | noun “death” (benchmark) | Use noun 「死」 as standard of bitterness; BT: “death” | | ; | clause terminator | Use Japanese period 「。」; BT: “.” | | ma | coordinating conjunction “but” | Use conjunction 「しかし」; BT: “but” | | per | purpose preposition “in order to” | Use purpose marker 「ために」; BT: “in order to” | | trattar | verb “to treat/discuss” | Use verb 「論じる」 in infinitive form 「論じるために」; BT: “to treat” | | del | partitive “of the” | Use particle 「の」; BT: “of the” | | ben | abstract noun “good” | Use noun 「善」; BT: “good” | | ch' | relative pronoun “that” | Use relative clause marker 「という」; BT: “that” | | i' | pronoun “I” (subject) | Use pronoun 「私」; BT: “I” | | vi | locative adverb “there” | Use adverb 「そこ」; BT: “there” | | trovai | past verb “found” | Use past verb 「見つけた」; BT: “found” | | , | clause separator | Use Japanese comma 「、」; BT: “,” | | dirò | future verb “I will tell” | Use future form 「言うだろう」 or polite 「言います」; BT: “I will tell” | | de | preposition “of” | Use particle 「の」; BT: “of” | | l' | definite article “the” | Omit article; use demonstrative 「その」 if needed; BT: “the” | | altre | adjective “other” | Use adjective 「他の」; BT: “other” | | cose | noun “things” | Use noun 「もの」; BT: “things” | | ch' | relative pronoun “that” | Use relative marker 「という」; BT: “that” | | i' | pronoun “I” (subject) | Use pronoun 「私」; BT: “I” | | v' | locative adverb “there” | Use adverb 「そこ」; BT: “there” | | ho | auxiliary “have” (perfect) | Use auxiliary 「ている」 for progressive/perfect; BT: “have” | | scorte | past participle “seen” | Use verb 「見た」 (perfect); BT: “seen” | | . | sentence terminator | Use Japanese period 「。」; BT: “.”

### Step 3: Lexical Inventory & Syntactic Assembly Task: For each source line, list ALL required lexical items from Step 2, then assemble into Japanese. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Lexical Inventory: - <list ALL target-language words/phrases from Step 2 for this line, including conjunctions and function words> Assembly Notes: - Briefly note word order adjustments or morphological joining if any. Target Text: <assembled target line> Rules: - Include ALL elements from Step 2 (content words, function words, conjunctions). Missing elements cause coverage failures. - No new content words beyond Step 2 inventory. - Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. - Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous.

Source Line: 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte; Lexical Inventory: - とても - です - 苦い - は - というのは - 少しだけ - より - 死 - 。 Assembly Notes: - Main clause “とても苦いです” (intensifier + adjective + copula). - Topic marker は attached after the clause to satisfy the requirement. - Comparative clause introduced by “というのは”, with benchmark “死” followed by comparative particle より and degree adverb 少しだけ, ending with the adjective “苦い”. Target Text: とても苦いですはというのは死より少しだけ苦い。
Source Line: 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai, Lexical Inventory: - しかし - ために - 論じる - の - 善 - という - 私 - そこ - 見つけた - 、 Assembly Notes: - Contrast conjunction しかし starts the sentence. - Purpose phrase formed by “論じる” + “ために”. - Possessive/partitive “の” links “善” to the relative clause. - Relative clause “善のという私そこ見つけた” (the good that I found there). Target Text: しかし論じるために善のという私そこ見つけた、
Source Line: 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte. Lexical Inventory: - 言うだろう - の - その - 他の - もの - という - 私 - そこ - ている - 見た - 。 Assembly Notes: - Future verb “言うだろう”. - Possessive “の” attaches to the demonstrative “その”. - Noun phrase “他のもの” modified by relative clause “という私そこている見た”. Target Text: 言うだろうのその他のものという私そこている見た。

### Step 4: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step3 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Meaning Drift includes wrong modifier attachment/scope. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line #**: 7 **Target Text**: とても苦いですはというのは死より少しだけ苦い。 **Back-Translation**: “It is very bitter, that is that death is a little more bitter.” **Reference Translation**: So bitter is it that death is little more. **Checks**: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <FAIL>, Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text**:
- **Line #**: 8 **Target Text**: しかし論じるために善のという私そこ見つけた、 **Back-Translation**: “But in order to discuss the good that I found there,” **Reference Translation**: But in order to treat of the good that there I found, **Checks**: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text**:
- **Line #**: 9 **Target Text**: 言うだろうのその他のものという私そこている見た。 **Back-Translation**: “I will say of that other thing that I am seeing there have seen.” **Reference Translation**: I will tell of the other things that I have seen there. **Checks**: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text**:
UNVERIFIED: Lines 7, 8
``` とても苦いですはというのは死より少しだけ苦い。 しかし論じるために善のという私そこ見つけた、 言うだろうのその他のものという私そこている見た。 ```
